The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow markings on its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the eyes are visible with a slight glint. The forelimbs and hindlimbs are splayed out, showing short digits. The tail extends towards the right edge of the frame.
